rules.title: San Francisco Rent Ordinance annual allowable rent increase
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units in San Francisco, the annual allowable rent increase is 1.6% for the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.coverage_conditions: Units covered by the San Francisco Rent Ordinance's rent increase limitations; this page does not state the coverage criteria.
rules.citation: San Francisco Rent Ordinance (S.F. Admin. Code ch. 37); Rent Board Topic No. 571 Allowable Annual Increases
rules.quoted_span:
Allowable Rent Increase:
1.6% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.conflict_note: This rates page does not state the ordinance section or the building-coverage criteria (such as the certificate-of-occupancy cutoff), so those coverage fields are left null. Prior rates: 1.4% for 2025-26 and 1.7% for 2024-25.

rules.title: San Francisco security deposit interest rate
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay interest on tenant security deposits at the Rent Board rate, which is 4.2% for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.coverage_conditions: San Francisco residential tenancies with security deposits subject to the city's deposit-interest requirement; this page does not state the coverage criteria.
rules.citation: San Francisco Rent Board Topic No. 572 Security Deposit Interest Rates
rules.quoted_span:
Security Deposit Interest:
4.2% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.conflict_note: This page gives only the rate, not the underlying ordinance citation. Prior rates: 5.0% for 2025-26 and 5.2% for 2024-25.

rules.title: Relocation payments for owner/relative move-in, demolition/removal, temporary capital improvement and substantial rehabilitation evictions
rules.requirement: For eviction notices served from 3/1/26 to 2/28/27 for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation, the landlord owes $8,245 per tenant, up to $24,733 per unit. An additional $5,497 is owed for each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with minor children.
rules.key_value: $8,245/tenant; max $24,733/unit; +$5,497 per elderly/disabled tenant or household with minor children
rules.coverage_conditions: San Francisco tenants evicted for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal of the unit, temporary capital improvement work (20 days or more), or substantial rehabilitation.
rules.exemptions: Temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days are governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9, not § 37.9C.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only to evictions based on the listed no-fault grounds

rules.title: Relocation payments for Ellis Act evictions
rules.requirement: For Ellis Act eviction notices served from 3/1/26 to 2/28/27, the landlord owes $11,110.05 per tenant, up to $33,330.13 per unit. An additional $7,443.90 is owed for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant.
rules.coverage_conditions: San Francisco tenants evicted under the Ellis Act (withdrawal of units from the rental market).

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only to Ellis Act withdrawal evictions

rules.title: Relocation payments for temporary displacement of less than 20 days
rules.requirement: For temporary capital improvement displacements of less than 20 days, with notices served from 3/1/26 to 2/28/27, the landlord owes $446 per day per tenant household plus actual moving expenses.
rules.key_value: $446.00/day per tenant household plus actual moving expenses
rules.coverage_conditions: San Francisco tenant households temporarily displaced for capital improvement work for less than 20 days.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only to temporary displacements of less than 20 days for capital improvement work
